source: Aggregated anonymous LocalClaw model-page traffic measured by DataFast
metric: unique visitors whose current canonical LocalClaw /models/ page was observed
claimBoundary: Model-page interest only. A page visit is not verified model use and does not prove a download, installation, launch, or inference.

methodology.dimension: hostname + country + current exact canonical model path
methodology.modelPathRule: Exact allow-list match to an eligible canonical /models/${APP_DATA.models[].id} page.
methodology.modelVisitorAggregation: Each de-duplicated DataFast visitor contributes once, to the most recently observed eligible model page in the selected window.
methodology.brandAggregation: The visitor is grouped under the canonical LocalClaw model logo attached to that page.
methodology.publicationRule: Every observed aggregate cell is published from one visitor. Zero-observation cells remain empty.
methodology.genericLogoRule: Generic hosting-platform logo groups github and huggingface remain excluded as model brands.
methodology.rankingRule: Countries rank by observed all-model visitors. Co-leading brands are preserved.
methodology.geographyNote: Country and region are approximate network locations, not verified residence or nationality.
methodology.privacyNote: Only aggregate counts are public. Visitor identifiers, IP addresses, devices, cities and raw rows are excluded.
methodology.caveat: Results measure LocalClaw page interest and can be affected by search demand, page age, referrals and catalogue availability.
